title: WorkspaceContextResponse
description: Response body for GET /api/workspace/context (HEL-371) — a server-side, owner-scoped snapshot of the caller's data sources, DataTypes, pipelines, and dashboards. Structural parity with helio-mcp/src/context.ts's WorkspaceContext interface, with two documented deltas: (1) `pipelineShapes` is intentionally OMITTED — not part of this ticket's scope/acceptance criteria, and PipelineShapeService is stateless/code-level with no per-user RLS story (design.md D4); a later ticket may add it. (2) `pipelines[].steps[]` carries the FULL per-step field set the MCP interface has — `position`, `type`, `outputColumns`, `validationError` — not just `outputColumns` (design-gate note 3): all four are already produced by the existing analyze path at zero extra cost, so the schema documents full parity rather than a narrowed subset.

generatedAt.description: ISO-8601 instant this snapshot was assembled.

Counts.description: Each field is the resource kind's true PagedResult.total (design.md D3), not the possibly page-truncated items.length — dataSources/dataTypes/dashboards are fetched with Page.Default (limit 200, parity with the MCP's own unparameterized fan-out), so counts can exceed the corresponding array's length for a workspace over 200 of a given kind.

tag.description: Absent on the wire (not null) when unset — spray-json omits a None Option field entirely rather than emitting `null`; not in `required` for that reason.

sourceId.description: Present for a source-companion DataType, ABSENT on the wire (not null) for a pipeline-output DataType — spray-json omits a None Option field entirely rather than emitting `null`; not in `required` for that reason. Use `pipelineOutput` for the classification, not the presence/absence of this field.

pipelineOutput.description: true iff sourceId is absent — a panel-bindable, pipeline-produced DataType (V41 rule).

tag.description: Absent on the wire (not null) when unset — see sourceId's description for the same spray-json omission behavior.

validationError.description: Absent on the wire (not null) when the step is valid — spray-json omits a None Option field entirely rather than emitting `null`; not in `required` for that reason.

lastRunStatus.description: Absent on the wire (not null) when the pipeline has never run — spray-json omits a None Option field entirely rather than emitting `null`; not in `required` for that reason (applies to every field below with this same description).

steps.description: Populated from the existing analyze path, in step order. Empty when stepsError is set (design.md D5 per-pipeline degrade).

stepsError.description: Set (non-null) when this pipeline's analyze call failed — steps is [] in that case; ABSENT on the wire (not null) when analyze succeeded (spray-json omits a None field entirely). Mirrors helio-mcp/src/context.ts's per-pipeline try/catch; a single pipeline's failure never fails the whole request.

panelCount.description: Count of distinct panelIds referenced across all four responsive breakpoints (lg/md/sm/xs) of the dashboard's layout.
